contexts.text: These changes are called in the Prophets ordinances. Illustrated.
(A covenant was established also) by the rites of the Church enjoined by the Lord, which are called statutes. AE 701:22.
The externals of worship were... many other things which were called statutes.
Kept My... statutes, etc. () = that by continual revelations from Himself... He united the Divine essence to the human... Statutes = the external things of the Word.
He Himself was the statute...
Statutes = the external things of the Word, such as rituals, and those things which are representative and significative of the internal sense. Illustrated.
In both (Churches) there are nearly similar external rituals, that is, similar statutes, laws, and precepts.
They were only required to keep the statutes and precepts in the external form.
A sojourner = those who suffered themselves to be instructed in their statutes and doctrinals. Illustrated.
This [ancient] statute was known not only to Jacob and his sons, but also to Shechem and Hamor... for the statutes, judgments, and laws given to the (Israelites) were not new... AC 4449:2. AC 4835.
This, like all the other precepts, judgments, and statutes in the Jewish Church, was representative...
Joseph appointed it for a statute () = what is concluded from consent. Explained.

An eternal statute () = the order of Heaven... because all the statutes commanded the sons of Israel were such things as flowed from the order of Heaven; whence they also represented the things which are of Heaven.
An eternal statute () = according to Divine order. AC 7931.

This is the statute of the passover () = the laws of order for those delivered... For all the statutes commanded them were laws of order in the external form; but the things they represented were laws of order in the internal form. The laws of order are the truths which are from good.
Thou shalt keep this statute at a stated time from year to year () = that this law of order should be in this state constantly.

There he set for him a statute and a judgment () = the truth of order then revealed. A statute = the external truth of the Church... The reason a statute = the external truth of order, is that every external [truth] of the Church was called a statute; and every internal truth of order, a judgment.

If thou wilt keep all His statutes () = a life according to the truths of faith, which are the exterior things of the Church. Statutes = the external truths of the Word; thus the truths of faith which are the exterior things of the Church.
When statutes and precepts are mentioned together, a statute = what is external of the Church; and a precept, what is internal of it.

Thou shalt teach them statutes and laws () = that from truth immediately from the Lord come the external and internal goods and truths of the Church... Statutes = the external goods and truths of the Church.
The ten precepts = internal truths; and the laws and statutes delivered in the following chapters = external truths.
As all the statutes which the Lord commanded the sons of Israel were founded on the laws of order which are in Heaven... those delivered concerning thefts are so founded. Enumerated.
The laws commanded the sons of Israel were distinguished into precepts, judgments, and statutes... Statutes were those things which were of worship. AC 8972:3, Illustrated. AC 9282. AC 9417.

This is why the man of the Christian Church is not bound to observe those judgments and statutes in the external form, but in the internal. Nevertheless holiness abides in them, because they contain holy things in them... for when they are read by a Christian man, the Divine things in them, and which were represented, are apperceived in the Heavens, and fill the Angels with what is holy, and at the same time the man who is reading them, by influx from the Angels; and still more so if the man himself at the same time thinks about the Divine things which are in them.
Furthermore, all the laws, in so far as they were of a representative Church, were called in general judgments and statutes. Illustrated.
Under Law, see this reference. AC 9349:3.
The statutes, etc. which are to be observed and done; those which serve for use if one pleases; and those which have been abrogated. (See Law.)
The statute of an age () = Divine order... which is eternal.
The statute of an age to him and his seed after him () = the laws of order in the representative Church. The statute of an age = the law of Divine order in the Heavens and in the Church.
For the statute of an age () = according to the eternal laws of order. A statute = a law of order. AC 10095. AC 10248.
They send to the inquisition those not willing to receive their religious decrees.
treats of the statutes, judgments, and precepts which they were to keep; and, as these = Divine truths, it is said, Ye shall be holy. AE 204:8.
The ordinances of the moon and stars () = truths from spiritual good, and from Knowledges. ( = all things which are done in the natural man according to the laws of order. AE 401:22.)
The life of charity is meant by walking in the statutes, and keeping the precepts, and doing them (); for this is charity.
Statutes and judgments = such things as teach rituals.
Statutes and judgments () = external and internal truths which are from good.

Statutes of the heart, and searchings of heart () = truths from good which are in the natural man from the spiritual man... Statutes and searchings of the heart = all things which are determined and ordinated in the natural man from good in the spiritual man.
The ordinances of the sun, moon, and stars... and the ordinances of heaven and earth () = like things to those which are signified by times; for times come forth from these ordinances.
Ordinances, here () = all the things of the Church which were commanded the sons of Israel; thus all things of worship.
I will announce concerning the statute () = an arcanum of the Divine providence and will. ( = His advent. AE 850:3.)
Statutes () = the laws of external worship.

The covenant of day and night, and the ordinances of heaven and earth () = the conjunction of the Lord with those who are in Divine truths in the Heavens, and with those who are in Divine truths on earth; covenant = conjunction; and ordinances, the laws of conjunction, which are the laws of order; and the laws of order are Divine truths.
The set time () = His advent.
In many passages... statutes = the laws of worship. Illustrated.
In these passages, statutes = the laws of worship which related especially to sacrifices and holy ministrations.
When the sons of Israel had wholly departed from the statutes which were representative of the spiritual things of the Church... they were given into the hands of the king of Assyria...
The statutes of the nations are vanity () = all things of worship of those who are in evil.
